claim.claim: Amazon's net sales for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 increased by more than 10% year over year.

verdict.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: Sales increased 12% in Q3 2026, and 16% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

verdict.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Amazon's net sales for Q3 2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026) increased by more than 10% year over year. The evidence clearly refers to the same period (Q3 2026 ending September 30, 2026) and provides the year-over-year growth rate for net sales.
